scripts.api:dev: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir apps/api
scripts.api:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.demo:bank: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec api python -m app.bank_demo
scripts.demo:invoices: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec api python -m app.invoice_demo
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @umkm/web lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @umkm/web typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/app
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @umkm/web test:run && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.quality: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
